# Skytype

> Minimal, zero-history, end-to-end encrypted snippet and API response bundler.

## Overview
Skytype lets developers paste API responses, code snippets, JSON, YAML, or Markdown notes, format them cleanly, and share them via a single end-to-end encrypted link.

## Privacy & Security Architecture
- **Client-side AES-GCM encryption**: All encryption and decryption happen locally in the browser using the Web Crypto API.
- **Zero-knowledge backend**: Only opaque ciphertext blobs are stored on the server; plaintext and encryption keys are never sent to the API.
- **URL fragment keys**: Decryption keys live strictly in the URL `#fragment`, which is never transmitted to servers.
- **Zero history**: No user accounts, no login flows, and no per-user history lists.
